evidence.notes: If every preregistered primary structural metric is at its zero target within 1e-12 and the experiment command succeeds, register attacking evidence because the candidate sheaf compatibility energy carries no incremental local-residual information over the strong independent residual baseline on these fixtures. Do not infer anything about computational efficiency, kriging or QC baselines, higher-order sheaf quantities, or real climate-data fault detection.
evidence.scope: Deterministic finite real-valued linear-network fixtures only; this evidence concerns local compatibility-energy information relative to an independently computed local-residual baseline and does not evaluate real station networks.
threats_to_validity: The fixtures are deterministic finite linear networks, not observed climate station networks.
The strong local-residual baseline receives the same restriction maps as the candidate, so this evaluates incremental local compatibility information rather than restriction-map discovery.
The evaluation does not compare computational efficiency, kriging, interpolation, or standard quality-control procedures.
Degree-zero compatibility energy does not exhaust higher cochain, cohomological, spectral, or reconstruction quantities.
A null incremental-information result on these fixtures does not imply that richer sheaf structure lacks value on other preregistered tasks.
